title: Project the exact-A ordinary serving-revision backlog guard

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Exact-A serving guard tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_serving_revision_guard.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent packaged T2 verification passed the exact-A five-state matrix, proving pending/processing blockers, terminal-state non-blockers, SPA/admission-A/exact-state lineage, SELECT-only behavior, unchanged snapshots, safe cleanup and no TASK-040 scope leakage.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#ordinary-serving-revision-guard RED: processing has no read-only exact-A projection that distinguishes the current SPA's A-admitted pending or processing backlog from terminal A work; GREEN: given a stable serving context and exact A, the projection reports a blocker for pending and processing and no blocker for ready, no_faces and failed while examining only each A-admitted Photo's exact (photo_id, A) state; decisive comparison: the five-case disposable state matrix returns the specified result and SELECT-only snapshots show no serving selection, Photo, state, B-state, asset or process mutation; artifact: focused processing test output and read-only query trace.
purpose: Provide the processing-owned read-only backlog guard required before a later serving-control command may decide whether to replace current revision A.
success_outcome: For one stable SPA serving context and exact current A, processing returns the authoritative non-terminal-A blocker result without claiming work, creating B state or mutating Photo, processing or serving data.
anti_goals: Do not implement a serving-control command, serving selection update, admission serialization, deployment action or audited switch result.
Do not create a B state, mutate an A state, select a revision, claim work, add a switch lifecycle, registry, job, persisted mode or automatic drain.
Do not add model comparison, Calibration execution, transport, staff roles, authentication behavior or realtime query work.

forbidden_scope: The serving_control manual command, serving-selection commit and admission/switch serialization owned by TASK-040-T2-FT-002-W7
Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation, comparison execution and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Model asset deployment, worker/realtime restart, automatic rollback or direct database edits as an ordinary revision-switch path
stop_conditions: A correct guard requires processing to select serving revision, mutate an A or B state, inspect a non-A admission lineage, or add a switch lifecycle/state.
The exact-A result cannot be supplied through the accepted read-only processing boundary without a new ownership edge or durable coordination mechanism.
Correctness would require a public transport/auth contract, model-comparison integration or deployment behavior.

constraints: Processing receives the stable serving context and exact current A, considers only the SPA's Photos with immutable admission_pipeline_revision_id=A and their exact composite-key state, and returns only the read-only guard result.
pending and processing are blockers; ready, no_faces and failed are terminal non-blockers.

Use validated disposable A/B revisions, one SPA and task-owned Photos with known state, safe rerun and complete cleanup; retain the existing caller authorization boundary without adding a transport or role.
invariants: The guard never claims work, creates a B state, mutates an A state, selects B or changes model assets, deployment or process state.
The guard reads no later/non-admission revision as a substitute for exact A state.
serving_control remains the sole owner that can turn the guard result into a revision decision.
verification_targets: A disposable exact-A matrix independently sets one A-admitted Photo to pending, processing, ready, no_faces and failed and proves only the first two return blockers.

Read-only trace and before/after projections prove the guard limits selection to SPA/A admission lineage and exact A state, makes no write and creates no B state; the fixture has known initial state, safe rerun and task-owned cleanup.
